objective: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to Bloodmage Lynnore.

description: These wastelands are riddled with redstone basilisk, <name>. These basilisk have adapted and flourished, more so than any of the other wildlife within the region.
I have watched from afar as they hunt and go about their daily activities - the beasts exhibit a thought process more complex than even some humanoids.
Retrieve ten of their brains for me, <name>. The compound cannot be complete, however, without two vulture gizzards to form the base of the solution.
progress: Have you returned with the requested organs?
completion: This is wondrous, <name>! My offering to you is a taste of the inner workings of the redstone basilisk.
Should the compound be to your liking, more can always be made... for a price.
